```{r}
# Function to escape LaTeX special characters
escape_latex <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", x)
  x <- gsub("&", "\\\\&", x)
  x <- gsub("%", "\\\\%", x)
  x <- gsub("\\$", "\\\\$", x)
  x <- gsub("#", "\\\\#", x)
  x <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", x)
  x <- gsub("\\{", "\\\\{", x)
  x <- gsub("\\}", "\\\\}", x)
  x <- gsub("~", "\\\\textasciitilde{}", x)
  x <- gsub("\\^", "\\\\textasciicircum{}", x)
  return(x)
}
```

# Education

```{r}
edu %>%
  group_by(Degree, Institution, Where, Year) %>%
  summarize(details = list(Why[!is.na(Why) & Why != "NA"]), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(Year)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Degree, Institution, Where), escape_latex)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    has_details = length(details) > 0 && length(details[[1]]) > 0,
    Why_escaped = if(has_details) {
      paste(map_chr(details[[1]], escape_latex), collapse = '\n\n')
    } else {
      ""
    },
    output = paste(
      paste0("\\subsection{", Degree, "}"),
      paste0("\\textit{", Institution, "}, ", Where, " \\hfill ", Year),
      if(Why_escaped != "") Why_escaped else "",
      sep = if(Why_escaped != "") "\n\n" else ""
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(output) %>%
  cat(sep = "\n\n")
```

# Research and Data Experience

```{r}
job %>% 
  filter(presentation == 0, other_honors == 0, research == 1, primary == 'research') %>% 
  mutate(
    is_consulting = str_detect(tolower(job), "consult"),
    when = if_else(year_end == 'NULL', as.character(year_start), paste0(year_start, " - ", year_end))
  ) %>%
  group_by(position, job, Location, when, year_start, is_consulting) %>%
  summarize(activities = list(activity[!is.na(activity) & activity != "NA"]), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(year_start), is_consulting, job, position) %>%
  mutate(across(c(position, job, Location), escape_latex)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    has_activities = length(activities) > 0 && length(unlist(activities)) > 0,
    items = if(has_activities) {
      escaped_activities <- map_chr(unlist(activities), escape_latex)
      paste(paste0('\\item ', escaped_activities), collapse = '\n')
    } else {
      ""
    }
  ) %>%
  filter(has_activities) %>%
  mutate(
    output = paste(
      paste0("\\subsection{", position, "}"),
      paste0("\\textit{", job, "}, ", Location, " \\hfill ", when),
      "\\begin{itemize}",
      items,
      "\\end{itemize}",
      sep = "\n\n"
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(output) %>%
  cat(sep = "\n\n")
```

# Publications

```{r}
bib_text <- paste(readLines(here::here("data", "my_publications.bib"), warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "\n")

extract_field <- function(entry_text, field) {
  m <- regexpr(paste0("\\b", field, "\\s*=\\s*\\{"), entry_text, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
  if (m[1] == -1) return(NA_character_)
  chars <- strsplit(entry_text, "")[[1]]
  open_pos <- m[1] + attr(m, "match.length") - 1L
  depth <- 1L
  i <- open_pos + 1L
  n <- length(chars)
  while (i <= n && depth > 0L) {
    if (chars[i] == "{") depth <- depth + 1L
    else if (chars[i] == "}") depth <- depth - 1L
    if (depth > 0L) i <- i + 1L
  }
  value <- paste(chars[(open_pos + 1L):(i - 1L)], collapse = "")
  trimws(gsub("[{}]", "", value))
}

format_authors <- function(raw) {
  if (is.na(raw) || !nzchar(raw)) return("")
  people <- trimws(strsplit(raw, "\\s+and\\s+")[[1]])
  formatted <- vapply(people, function(p) {
    if (grepl(",", p)) {
      parts <- strsplit(p, ",")[[1]]
      last <- trimws(parts[1])
      first <- trimws(paste(parts[-1], collapse = ","))
      if (nzchar(first)) paste(first, last) else last
    } else {
      p
    }
  }, character(1))
  paste(formatted, collapse = ", ")
}

entry_starts <- gregexpr("@[A-Za-z]+\\s*\\{", bib_text, perl = TRUE)[[1]]
entry_ends <- c(entry_starts[-1] - 1L, nchar(bib_text))
entry_chunks <- substring(bib_text, entry_starts, entry_ends)

pubs <- map_dfr(entry_chunks, function(chunk) {
  author_raw <- extract_field(chunk, "author")
  editor_raw <- extract_field(chunk, "editor")
  collaborator_raw <- extract_field(chunk, "collaborator")

  authors <- if (!is.na(author_raw)) {
    base <- format_authors(author_raw)
    if (!is.na(editor_raw)) paste0(base, " (", format_authors(editor_raw), ", ed.)") else base
  } else if (!is.na(editor_raw)) {
    paste0(format_authors(editor_raw), " (ed.)")
  } else if (!is.na(collaborator_raw)) {
    paste0(format_authors(collaborator_raw), " (collab.)")
  } else {
    ""
  }

  org_raw <- extract_field(chunk, "institution")
  if (is.na(org_raw)) org_raw <- extract_field(chunk, "publisher")
  if (is.na(org_raw)) org_raw <- extract_field(chunk, "journal")

  tibble(
    title = extract_field(chunk, "title"),
    year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(extract_field(chunk, "year"))),
    authors = authors,
    org = if (is.na(org_raw)) "" else org_raw,
    url = extract_field(chunk, "url")
  )
})

pubs %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  mutate(
    year_part = if_else(!is.na(year), paste0(" (", year, ")."), ""),
    org_part = if_else(nzchar(org), paste0(" \\textit{", escape_latex(org), "}."), ""),
    link_part = if_else(!is.na(url) & nzchar(url), paste0(" \\href{", url, "}{", url, "}"), ""),
    item = paste0(
      "\\item \\textbf{", escape_latex(title), "}", year_part,
      " ", escape_latex(authors), ".", org_part, link_part
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(item) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n") %>%
  {paste0("\\begin{itemize}\n", ., "\n\\end{itemize}")} %>%
  cat()
```
